note: KDWP state fishing lake 6 miles north and 2 miles west of Canton, managed with the adjoining Maxwell Wildlife Refuge (bison and elk). The camping is the wooded campground along the gravel shore road on the west side of the lake, with gravel pull-offs, fire rings and vault toilets near the fishing piers and the west boat ramp. The open field with the herringbone pull-ins west of that road is Battlehill RV Park, a private park, not the state lake. Fishing boats only; no alcohol or firearms; trash to the dumpster by the west toilet. --Claude
